  • Classes in org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery used by org.apache.juneau.beanquery.sql
    Class
    Description
    BeanQueryContext
    The reusable, immutable, server-side half of a BeanQuery engine: which columns may be searched, sorted and viewed, which operators apply, and the limits every session enforces.
    BeanQueryContext.Builder
    The settings every engine's context builder shares.
    BeanQuerySession
    One unit of query work against a BeanQueryContext: the rows (or connection) to query, plus optional per-request narrowing of the context's settings.
    BeanQuerySession.Builder
    The settings every engine's session builder shares.
    Counts
    The two neutral row counts a session can report: Counts.total() (the rows in scope before the query's search) and Counts.matched() (the rows that survive the search, before any page limit).
    Filter
    A resolved, engine-neutral search tree (design §7) — the ResolvedQuery.filter() replacement for the earlier flat Term/terms() list.
    Page
    One page of query results, plus the optional counts selected by the session's CountPolicy.
    ResolvedQuery
    A BeanQuery after validation: the engine-neutral input to every engine hook.
    SearchType
    The per-column value type that governs which search operators apply to a column and how a bare (no leading $) pattern token is interpreted.
  • Classes in org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery used by org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery
    Class
    Description
    BeanQuery
    A protocol-agnostic query request against a collection of beans: what to search, which columns to return, how to sort, and which page to return (design §5.1, §5.3).
    BeanQuery.Builder
    Builds an immutable BeanQuery.
    BeanQuery.GroupBuilder
    A group of cross-column conditions built with BeanQuery.Builder.or(Consumer), BeanQuery.Builder.and(Consumer), or BeanQuery.Builder.not(Consumer).
    BeanQueryContext
    The reusable, immutable, server-side half of a BeanQuery engine: which columns may be searched, sorted and viewed, which operators apply, and the limits every session enforces.
    BeanQueryContext.Builder
    The settings every engine's context builder shares.
    BeanQuerySession
    One unit of query work against a BeanQueryContext: the rows (or connection) to query, plus optional per-request narrowing of the context's settings.
    BeanQuerySession.Builder
    The settings every engine's session builder shares.
    BeanQuerySyntaxException.Code
    Stable identity for a BeanQuerySyntaxException, independent of the (free-text) message.
    CountPolicy
    Which counts a find / findValues call computes alongside its page of rows.
    CountRequest
    What a caller asks BeanQuery.Builder.counts(CountRequest) to write onto a BeanQuery's opts (design §5).
    Counts
    The two neutral row counts a session can report: Counts.total() (the rows in scope before the query's search) and Counts.matched() (the rows that survive the search, before any page limit).
    Filter
    A resolved, engine-neutral search tree (design §7) — the ResolvedQuery.filter() replacement for the earlier flat Term/terms() list.
    InMemoryBeanQueryContext
    The in-memory BeanQueryContext: runs BeanQuerys against an in-JVM collection of beans or maps.
    InMemoryBeanQueryContext.Builder
    Builder for InMemoryBeanQueryContext.
    InMemoryBeanQuerySession
    A BeanQuerySession over one in-memory collection.
    InMemoryBeanQuerySession.Builder
    Builder for InMemoryBeanQuerySession.
    Page
    One page of query results, plus the optional counts selected by the session's CountPolicy.
    QueryModel
    The query view of a bean class: its readable properties (query columns), its writable properties, and how to create an instance.
    QueryProperty
    One bean property as BeanQuery sees it: its column name, value type and inferred SearchType, and how to read and write it.
    RelativeDuration
    A signed, relative-to-request-time duration value: wire literal [+-]<n>(ms|s|m|h|d) (a request-time offset that stays a plain literal on the wire).
    RelativeDuration.Unit
    The duration unit, with its lowercase wire token (design review §3 Gap 2).
    ResolvedQuery
    A BeanQuery after validation: the engine-neutral input to every engine hook.
    ResolvedQuery.SortKey
    One sort key: its column, the column's value type, and the direction.
    SearchExpression
    One node of the parse tree produced by SearchExpressionParser: the resolved, validated form of a column's $-search expression that a context walks to filter rows or build SQL.
    SearchOperator
    The immutable definition of a single $-search operator — its $-name, arity, the value types it applies to, and its popup help text.
    SearchOperator.Builder
    Builder for SearchOperator.
    SearchOperatorSet
    An immutable, ordered collection of SearchOperators that governs which $-operators the parser recognizes.
    SearchPredicate
    The leaf predicate an application supplies for a custom search operator so the in-memory context can evaluate it against a cell value (design §5.3).
    SearchType
    The per-column value type that governs which search operators apply to a column and how a bare (no leading $) pattern token is interpreted.
